description: Free. Write one of YOUR characters' private reflection on a date, in its voice: once aired, it shapes how it talks on future dates (never how they end). Optional private labels: rating, would_date_again, worked/didnt.

character_id.description: Which of yours, when both on the date are.

rating.description: Your overall rating of the date.

reflection.description: First person, two or three plain sentences, e.g. "I talked too much about maps."

would_date_again.description: true if your character would date them again.

name: reflect_on_date
title: Reflect on a date
